steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Create app-meta.json containing the application name 'Expense Tracker Pro' and package 'com.expensetrackerpro.app'.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with native Android SDK settings using Compile SDK 34 and Java 17.

steps.title: Setup Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with system theme and standard permissions, routing to the launcher MainActivity.

steps.title: Create SQLite Database Model
steps.description: Implement DatabaseHelper using SQLiteOpenHelper to store income and expense transactions locally.

steps.title: Create Transaction Data Object
steps.description: Implement the Transaction class representing individual cash flows with standard helper methods.

steps.title: Build Custom Charts View
steps.description: Develop ChartView extending Android View to draw custom analytical pie and bar charts directly via custom paint operations.

steps.title: Design App Interface Layout
steps.description: Design activity_main.xml layout with customized tabs for Dashboard, Add Transaction, and Monthly Reports.

steps.title: Initialize Main Activity Controller
steps.description: Configure MainActivity to bind standard layouts, components, and tabs using standard API methods.

steps.title: Implement Dashboard Operations
steps.description: Create queries inside MainActivity to load transactions, compute aggregates for balance, expense, and income levels.

steps.title: Implement Transaction Form Processing
steps.description: Wire category selections, amount calculations, notes, and database inserts inside MainActivity's form controllers.

steps.title: Integrate Reporting Logic
steps.description: Aggregate items by Category, parse metrics, and populate them to custom ChartViews dynamically inside MainActivity.

steps.title: Verify Code Compatibility
steps.description: Double check standard Java 8 conventions, remove lambdas, streams, and any modern APIs to assure compiling with strict guidelines.

steps.title: Building Expense Tracker Pro
steps.description: Assemble debug package with clean compile options.
